## 中文

### 功能
- 通过局域网连接小米 / Redmi 显示器，调整画面、游戏辅助、输入信号和屏幕灯；支持 DDC/CI 的普通外接屏可在统一亮度面板中分别调光。
- 保存和切换画面预设，通过“编辑画面”修改后自动同步当前预设；自动任务支持跨午夜，时段结束后恢复进入任务前的设置。任务仅在应用运行并连接设备时生效。
- 自定义多组快捷键和托盘菜单，直接打开参数滑杆；支持浅色、深色及跟随系统主题。HDR / SDR 精密控光记忆可在设置中按需开启，默认关闭。

### 使用体验
- 开机静默驻留托盘并连接已保存的地址；网络晚就绪或连接中断后有限次退避重试，未授权时停止重试。再次打开程序会唤醒原实例。
- 断开和切换设备会清理旧连接；ADB Shell 跟随当前连接目标，避免打开旧地址。
- 修正快捷键和托盘调节后画面页可能不更新的问题；持续调节不再无限延长队列防抖等待，并减少对周期任务的阻塞。
- 允许只绑定需要的快捷键，兼容带空格和不带空格的组合键写法；信号源命令提交失败后可直接重试。自动任务默认使用基线，并改进输入错误提示、滑块显示及快捷键提示位置。

### 下载与兼容
下载 MimonitorToolbox.exe，双击即可运行。只提供一个 EXE，无需安装、解压或另配资源目录，也无需另装 Python、Node.js、Java 或 VC++ 运行库。

面向 Windows 10 / 11 x64，目前实机验证在 Windows 11 与 Redmi G Pro 27U 上完成；其他设备、固件、转接器和 Windows 10 的兼容性仍需实际确认。普通外接屏仅提供 DDC/CI 亮度调节。

---

## English

### Features
- Connect to Xiaomi / Redmi monitors over the local network to control picture settings, gaming aids, inputs and screen lighting. Adjust supported DDC/CI monitors separately in one brightness panel.
- Save and apply picture presets, with automatic saving after editing the active preset. Scheduled tasks support overnight periods and restore the settings captured before the task. Tasks require the app to remain running and connected.
- Customize multiple shortcut bindings and tray menu entries, open parameter sliders, and use light, dark or system appearance. Optional HDR / SDR local dimming memory is disabled by default.

### Everyday improvements
- Start quietly in the tray and connect to the saved address. Delayed network readiness and lost connections receive bounded retries; authorization failures stop retries. Launching the app again activates the existing instance.
- Disconnecting or changing targets cleans up the old connection. ADB Shell follows the current device rather than a cached address.
- Correct picture-page updates after shortcut and tray adjustments. Continuous input no longer extends debounce waits indefinitely and has less impact on periodic work.
- Save only the shortcuts you need, with or without spaces around modifier separators. Retry input-source operations after queue submission failures. Default new scheduled tasks to the baseline when no custom preset exists, with clearer input errors and improvements to slider and shortcut feedback placement.

### Download and compatibility
Download MimonitorToolbox.exe and run it directly. One EXE, with no installer, archive, companion resource folder, or separate Python, Node.js, Java or VC++ runtime installation.

Targets Windows 10 / 11 x64. Hardware checks so far cover Windows 11 and the Redmi G Pro 27U; other devices, firmware, adapters and Windows 10 still need verification. Standard external monitors receive DDC/CI brightness controls only.
